test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'DESIRE' is coded as 'GSKTGE'. What is the code for 'DIRECT' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (1) and (2) are added alternatively to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally. 

So,

 
• 'DESIRE' is coded as 'GSKTGE'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cb6922846d677b836f3a99c6eb342d03d5dfa04b2990ab9631f953a41cf8b6c.png] 

​Similarly, 

 
• 'DIRECT' is coded as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e4e1c14d92b87e85b5eb15daaaa5b1be9c9f7d83232f5b22a53830da5c3daa.png] 

​Hence, **"VDGSKE**" is the correct answer.

3d:T
